text:
Roman Josi is 36, playing 25.5 minutes a night, and Nashville has won four straight. He has 20 points in 17 games, 18 of them assists and 11 on the power play, and The Hockey News has him entering the Norris race.

Some of that is borrowed. With Josi on the ice, the Predators have scored 8.4 more goals than their chances deserve, which pads his total, and his own two goals came on 3.4 expected. His talent range sits around two points per 60 minutes; he's at 2.77. Even so, our projection of 77 points would be a strong season for a defenseman of any age.

The other story is where he finishes it. NHL Trade Talk wondered what it would take for Edmonton to land him, and Editor In Leaf and Hockey Patrol have linked him to Toronto. That's speculation for now, and a winning streak in Nashville makes a sale harder to picture. Evolving-Hockey had him 36th among 215 defensemen last season, with 2.5 goals of value from drawing more penalties than he takes.
headline: Josi's points are piling up, and so are the rumours
